This will fetch returns updated in the selected Date Range from Shopify and create Return Queue Jobs in Odoo. Marketplace > Queues.
Return Queue Jobs are processed automatically at certain time intervals. Each return is upserted as a Shopify Return with its line items.
When a return is OPEN, the matching incoming return picking is created in Odoo so the warehouse can see expected inventory.
When a return reaches CLOSED on Shopify, the linked return picking is auto-validated (stock moved to restock location).
When a return is DECLINED or CANCELED, any pending (not yet validated) return picking is cancelled.
Returns already CLOSED on both Shopify and Odoo are skipped (logged) to avoid redundant processing.

If Validate Inventory Adjustment? configuration is enabled under Instance setting, the system will automatically apply the inventory changes. Otherwise, you will need to manually process the inventory adjustment record in order for the stock changes to take effect.
